title: Sunset on pharmacy location rules removed
summary: The National Health Amendment (Pharmaceutical Benefits—Budget and Other Measures) Act 2018 repealed s 99Y of the National Health Act 1953, removing the sunset so the Australian Community Pharmacy Authority and location rules governing where new PBS-approved pharmacies may open continue beyond 30 June 2020.

instruments.title: National Health Amendment (Pharmaceutical Benefits—Budget and Other Measures) Act 2018
instruments.provisions: Schedule 5 (pharmacy location rules): repeals s 90(3C) and s 99Y

direction_rationale: Location rules restrict entry of new PBS-approved pharmacies near existing ones; removing the sunset entrenches this barrier and protects incumbents.

industries.name: Pharmaceutical, Cosmetic and Toiletry Goods Retailing

comparison: none: national rules; no observable change in the rules themselves at commencement
notes: Low evaluability: preserves the status quo; useful mainly as context. Location rules were previously extended to 30 Jun 2020 under the 6CPA.

verified.notes: Interpretation that s 99Y was the sunset is from a law-firm note.
